text: Quick recap. Tissue culture works because plant cells are totipotent, and the auxin to cytokinin ratio decides roots, callus or shoots. Breeders emasculate, bag, cross and select, and hybrids show heterosis. The Bt toxin is activated only in an insect's alkaline gut. Bio fertilizers are living organisms. Recombinant DNA uses restriction enzymes, ligase and a plasmid; PCR doubles DNA every cycle; gels sort fragments by size. And food safety is about quality, food security about access.
